jobs.title: Corporate FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Overview
Reporting to a Senior Corporate FP&A Manager, this position will primarily provide financial planning and analysis support to R&D and G&A department leaders. The position will also assist in building systems and processes that support Mainspring Energy’s long term growth.
Responsibilities
-
Partner with department leaders to build the annual plan. This includes establishing targets and collaborating with leaders to gather and document inputs to the financial plan

-
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for department leaders, highlighting key performance indicators

-
Conduct variance analysis to explain deviations from budget and forecast, identifying potential issues and areas for improvement

-
Build and maintain financial models that support business decisions, scenario analysis, and management reporting

-
Drive comparative analysis of Mainspring Energy with peer public companies

-
Support the Controller’s organization as needed; including close, variance explanations, and data analysis

-
Participate in the long-term financial planning process representing R&D and G&A department needs

-
Continuously improve FP&A processes, systems, and analytical capabilities to support the company as it scales

-
Support special projects, business cases, and ad-hoc analyses as needed
Qualifications
-
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics or related area; MBA, CFA, or CPA a plus

-
5+ years of relevant experience in a corporate finance or FP&A role, preferably in a company manufacturing a complex product or in the energy industry

-
Proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning

-
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis

-
Excellent communication and presentation skills to convey complex financial information to non-financial stakeholders

-
Deep understanding of financial accounting principles and business operations

-
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial software applications

-
Highly motivated team player driven to achieve exceptional results

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer – Continuous Improvement for Mechanical Design & Quality Control
jobs.description:
About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.
The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:
Pragmatic Optimism
Excellence without Ego
Proactive Collaboration



Job Overview
 
Do you have a knack for design of complex mechanical systems? Have you ever invented a tool or changed a process just to make routine installation or service faster and easier? If you're driven by solving real-world design challenges, especially within state of the art mechanical power generation equipment, then this role is built for you. 
 
Mainspring Energy is seeking a Continuous Improvement Engineer with a focus on mechanical design to lead product improvement efforts across our field and production systems. You will work on-site at a contract manufacturer, addressing design and manufacturing issues at their root. You will redesign critical components for durability and ease of service, integrate your findings back into the development process to ensure the long-term reliability and manufacturability of our products.  You will support manufacturing with a hands-on approach to solve complex mechanical problems working directly with the product to take measurement, perform testing, and support pilot efforts to develop rework/retrofit processes. 
You will redesign critical components for durability and ease of service, and integrate your findings back into the development process to ensure the long-term reliability and manufacturability of our products.  


Core Responsibilities
- Lead the root cause analysis of mechanical failures using data from diagnostics, hands-on testing, and fundamental analysis of bolted joints or material fatigue life

- Redesign or re-engineer components, fasteners, or assemblies to eliminate failures, reduce costs, or improve serviceability

- Work closely with design engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure that changes are thoroughly tested and validated with short feedback cycles

- Collaborate with NPI, manufacturing quality, and supply chain teams to ensure solutions are optimized for production, vendor capabilities, and field service

- Predict and prevent failure modes by applying a deep understanding of mechanical system interactions, tolerance stack-ups, and real-world use conditions

- Implement feedback loops from field issues into design standards and engineering processes to continuously improve product quality and reduce recurrence

- Create and manage internal improvement systems that embed learnings into manufacturing process flow and future design development efforts

- Support the development of service tooling, testing fixtures, or diagnostic aids as needed for improved deployment and serviceability

- Travel to HQ in Menlo Park, CA required once per quarter
Qualifications
- BS + 6 years, or MS + 5 years in industry roles with a focus on mechanical design

- Hands-on experience with mechanical design, including analysis of bolted joints, stress analysis, and structural integrity

- Proven ability to use data-driven root cause analysis to solve complex, cross-functional design issues

- Experience addressing and resolving field and production issues

- Knowledge of DFM/DFA principles and quality system tools (PFMEA, 8D, CAPA, etc.)

- Deep understanding of tolerance stack-ups and the use of CMMs in inspection processes

- Familiar with manufacturing processes including tube swaging, crimping, potting, stamping, sheet metal, hydroforming, welding, machining, and fabrication

- Proficient in SolidWorks or a comparable CAD package; PDM experience preferred

- Experience with structural FEA and/or is a plus

- A passion for building robust, field-ready solutions with high reliability and serviceability
Why Join Us?
- Directly influence the reliability and field performance of mission-critical mechanical systems

- Collaborate with top-tier engineering teams in a fast-paced and supportive environment

- Be part of an innovation-driven company working on impactful technologies

- Competitive compensation and a full benefits package

- Opportunities for technical leadership and long-term growth

jobs.title: Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.description:
About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Excellence without Ego

Position Overview
Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Vice President of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) leads Mainspring Energy's enterprise-wide financial planning, forecasting, long-range planning, and strategic financial analysis. This executive serves as a trusted advisor to the CFO and executive leadership team by translating financial and operational data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making.
This role is focused on enterprise financial strategy, top-down analysis, and long-range planning. The Vice President will lead the FP&A function through a team of experienced managers who oversee day-to-day budgeting, forecasting, and business partnering. The successful candidate will strengthen the analytical capabilities of the Finance organization, drive the company's strategic planning process, challenge assumptions with data, and help shape the financial strategy that supports Mainspring's next phase of growth.

Responsibilities
Strategic Financial Leadership

- Lead Mainspring's enterprise-wide financial planning and analysis function, ensuring alignment with the company's strategic and operational objectives.

- Partner closely with the CFO and executive leadership team to develop long-range financial strategies that support commercial growth, manufacturing scale, and capital allocation decisions.

- Lead the company's strategic planning process through enterprise scenario modeling and financial analysis that informs executive decision-making.

- Provide financial leadership and recommendations to support Board presentations, financing activities, and other strategic initiatives.

- Serve as a strategic advisor by proactively identifying financial risks, opportunities, and key business drivers that influence company performance.

Financial Planning & Analysis

- Provide executive oversight of the annual operating plan, quarterly forecasting process, and long-range financial planning.

- Review and challenge financial assumptions, operating plans, and resource allocation decisions across all business functions.

- Lead complex financial and operational analyses that provide actionable insights to executive leadership.

- Own the development of financial content for Board of Directors materials, including forecasts, key performance indicators, and strategic analyses.

- Continuously improve forecasting accuracy, analytical methodologies, and planning processes to support a rapidly scaling organization.

Executive Business Partnership

- Serve as a trusted finance partner to executive leaders across the organization, aligning financial priorities with business objectives.

- Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable business recommendations.

- Support evaluation of new products, manufacturing investments, pricing strategies, partnerships, and other strategic initiatives through rigorous financial analysis.

- Build alignment across cross-functional teams by connecting strategic financial objectives with operational execution.

Leadership & Organizational Development

- Lead and develop a high-performing FP&A organization through experienced managers responsible for budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and business partnering.

- Empower experienced leaders while establishing strategic priorities, coaching analytical excellence, and building organizational capabilities that scale with company growth.

- Promote collaboration across Finance and cross-functional teams to improve planning effectiveness and decision support.

Systems & Process Excellence

- Champion continuous improvement of financial planning processes, reporting capabilities, and analytical tools.

- Drive the evolution of financial planning systems, reporting automation, and business intelligence capabilities.

- Ensure the Finance organization leverages technology and data to deliver timely, accurate, and actionable financial insights.
Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field required; MBA, CFA, or CPA strongly preferred.

- 15+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Strategic Finance, or related disciplines, including significant leadership experience.

- Experience leading FP&A within a high-growth manufacturing, industrial technology, clean energy, or similarly complex operating environment.

- Prior experience in investment banking, private equity, management consulting, or another highly analytical finance discipline is strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated success partnering with executive leadership to influence strategic business decisions through data-driven financial analysis.

- Deep expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, long-range planning, scenario analysis, and business performance management.

- Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, supply chain, capital investments, and operational finance.

- Proven experience developing executive and Board-level presentations that communicate complex financial insights with clarity.

- Experience leading and developing high-performing finance organizations through multiple levels of management.

- Exceptional analytical, communication, and presentation skills with the executive presence to influence senior leaders across the organization.
What Success Looks Like
- Serves as a trusted strategic partner to the CFO and executive leadership team.

- Elevates the analytical capabilities of the Finance organization and improves executive decision-making.

- Develops scalable planning processes that support Mainspring's continued growth.

- Delivers clear, data-driven Board materials and executive analyses that influence strategic decisions.

- Builds a world-class FP&A organization that combines operational excellence with strategic insight.

jobs.description:
About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.
The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:
Pragmatic Optimism
Excellence without Ego

Job Overview
Mainspring is rapidly scaling manufacturing to meet growing customer demand and accelerate deployment of the world's most flexible and adaptable onsite power generation platform. As we expand production capacity and strengthen our supply chain, our contract manufacturing partners play a critical role in Mainspring's ability to deliver on its commitments to customers, investors, and stakeholders.

The leader of Contract Manufacturing & Strategic Partnerships will set the strategy and operating model for Mainspring's contract manufacturing network and serve as the executive owner of its most critical manufacturing partnerships. This leader will translate Mainspring's product, demand, and growth roadmaps into multi-year partner strategies that secure capacity, improve cost, quality, delivery, and inventory performance, and protect business continuity.

This role is accountable for the overall health and performance of the contract manufacturing portfolio. The leader will establish governance and executive business-review mechanisms, lead complex commercial negotiations, guide manufacturing readiness and production ramps, and drive rapid resolution of significant operational, quality, delivery, and relationship issues. The role will work closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Legal, Product Development, and Executive Leadership and will influence decisions across organizational boundaries.

Consistent with Mainspring's, this leader will build scalable processes and organizational capability, develop team members and future leaders, and operate with a high degree of autonomy. Success will be measured by partner performance, supply continuity, financial results, launch and ramp execution, risk reduction, and the strength of strategic relationships that enable Mainspring's long-term manufacturing strategy.
Key Responsibilities
-
Strategic Leadership: Execute the multi-year contract manufacturing strategy, ensuring full alignment with product roadmaps, capacity requirements, and company growth objectives.

-
Portfolio Management: Oversee the partner network, including strategic selection, allocation, and exit strategies based on capability, risk, and long-term fit.

-
Governance & MOS: Establish the organizational structure, decision rights, and Management Operating System (MOS) required to manage the contract manufacturing and related portfolio at scale.

-
Complex Negotiations: Lead executive-level commercial negotiations (MSAs, SOWs, pricing, tooling) to protect business interests and risks while fostering sustainable, long-term partnerships

-
Financial & Cost Strategy: Partner with executive leadership, Finance and Supply Chain to own cost performance, value engineering, and total-cost-of-ownership (TCO) initiatives as it relates to contract manufacturing. Clear ownership of contract manufacturers’ costs and pricing, driving transparency and accountability where necessary

-
Operational Readiness: Coordinate/support cross-functional readiness for), pilot builds, production ramps, and sustained volume manufacturing at our contract manufacturers

-
Performance Excellence: Establish rigorous KPIs (safety, quality, yield, delivery) and drive structured root-cause analysis and continuous improvement when performance falls below expectations

-
Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and mitigate supply chain and contract manufacturing operational, and geopolitical risks, ensuring robust business-continuity and contingency planning

-
Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Management: Provide concise, decision-oriented updates to leadership regarding performance, tradeoffs, and required investments, while driving cross-functional alignment

-
Team Leadership: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing team, fostering clear accountability and strengthening organizational capability
Qualifications
-
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Operations, or related field

-
10+ years in complex contract manufacturing, global supply chain, and/or operations, with at least 10 years specifically managing high-impact strategic supplier or CM portfolios

-
5+ years of people leadership experience, with a proven track record of building high-performing teams and developing future leaders

-
Demonstrated success in defining and executing multi-year contract manufacturing strategies that align with product roadmaps and company growth objectives

-
Deep understanding of the full manufacturing lifecycle, including production ramps, manufacturing transfers, and continuous improvement (safety, quality, yield, delivery)

-
Expertise leading complex, high business impact, executive-level negotiations (MSAs, SOWs, pricing, tooling) and managing financial performance, including TCO modeling, budgeting, and investment analysis

-
Proven ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries (Finance, Engineering, Quality) and drive alignment with internal and external stakeholders

-
Experience within high-growth industrial technology, energy, automotive, or similar complex hardware environments is highly preferred
Critical Success Factors
Success in this role requires:

-
Enterprise-level ownership and accountability for measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, capacity, risk, and partnership performance

-
Ability to set strategy and translate it into an executable operating model, roadmap, and performance cadence

-
Executive presence and credibility with internal leaders and external manufacturing partners

-
Balanced strategic thinking and hands-on operational leadership

-
Strong judgment in complex commercial, operational, and relationship decisions

-
Proactive communication, disciplined escalation, and clear decision recommendations

-
Ability to build/influence organizational capability, develop leaders, and create durable processes that scale

-
Confidence leading difficult conversations, negotiations, performance recovery, and change

Hands-on experience with PCBAs/SMT, cable and harness manufacturing, and e-box/box-build

PMP/CAPM or APICS/ASCM (CPIM or CSCP); AI or analytics tools for reporting automation
